name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2008 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2008 record supports: the techniques ATT&CK lists for the ATT&CK objects S0608 Conficker and S0092 Agent.btz, and behavior described by Microsoft's MS08-067, Advisory 954462, MS08-078 and its Conficker support article, CERT/CC's and NVD's records, CERT/CC's VU#593409 on Adobe Reader's util.printf() flaw, the Lynn article, the Cambridge report on the Dalai Lama's office, the CCDCOE report on Georgia, Belarus and Lithuania, Kaspersky's Fanny analysis, and the Justice Department and court records on the Gonzalez ring, Dave & Buster's, Wyndham, the Walker and Gembe indictment and the botnet sale charge. No 2008 source prints an ATT&CK id. The four group techniques ATT&CK lists for Equation and the three ATT&CK for ICS techniques it lists for Conficker are not in this layer. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2008.md. Scores: 100 the ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
